question: What was the theme of ICA Global Cooperative Conference in November 2024?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Cooperatives Build Prosperity for All**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• The ICA Global Cooperative Conference in November 2024 had the theme **"Cooperatives Build Prosperity for All."**
 
• It emphasized the role of cooperatives in fostering inclusive economic growth and equitable development across communities.
